review.tagline: MCP server adding hybrid semantic code search to coding agents
review.summary: Claude Context indexes a codebase into Milvus or Zilliz Cloud and exposes index_codebase, search_code, clear_index and get_indexing_status tools over stdio MCP. Search combines BM25 with dense vectors, chunks code with an AST splitter, and re-indexes only changed files using Merkle trees. It works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor and other MCP clients.
review.audience: Developers giving Claude Code or other agents search over large repos
strengths: Hybrid BM25 plus dense vector search over an indexed repo
Incremental re-indexing of changed files via Merkle trees
Embedding choice: OpenAI, VoyageAI, Ollama or Gemini
Also ships a core npm package and a VS Code extension
weaknesses: Needs a Milvus or Zilliz Cloud instance; no embedded vector store mentioned
Default setup sends code to OpenAI for embeddings unless Ollama is configured
README claims ~40% token reduction from its own evaluation only
No tagged releases listed on the repository
needs: Needs Node.js >= 20, Milvus or Zilliz Cloud, OpenAI API key (default embedding provider)
